name: credo #17
description:
CREDO

The Metaverse exists through belief, as a crisp crypto winter tests our reserve, let art and music guide us. 

A future built on the remains of the past. Credo in Futurum. 

Web2 websites, logos, terms and conditions get rekt, repurposed and reused. Credo in Artem. 

Renditions of renaissance prayer confirm the belief of us all. Credo in Musicam. 

Gathering the remaining degens together. Credo in Amorem. 

Our belief is universal. Credo in Metaversum.

Credo in Metaversum.
Lumen de lumine.
Expecto!
Vitam venturi saeculi.
Credo in Metaversum.
Credo!

Music by plutonic mind.
Art by strayltd.
Latin translation by mymarc.

Funded by the Federal Government Commissioner for Culture and Media as part of Neustart Kultur.
